name: mock_llm_quality_momentum_v1
hypothesis: A short moving-average return combined with a volatility penalty may favor steadier recent winners after the daily close.
economic_rationale: The momentum term captures gradual price adjustment while the volatility term penalizes unstable moves that may reverse.
risk_notes: Short horizon can create high turnover
Sensitive to suspension and limit-up execution

name: mock_llm_quality_momentum_feedback_v2
hypothesis: Lengthening both the return and risk windows may reduce noise and turnover while retaining the original quality-momentum idea.
economic_rationale: A slower signal reacts less to one-day price noise. A stronger risk penalty reduces exposure to volatile recent moves.
risk_notes: Longer windows react slowly to regime changes
Still requires out-of-sample and neutralization tests
Backtest feedback can overfit the same sample
